text: iPhone port step 3: the iOS shell, built on hosted macOS CI, TestFlight

From T-352: on iOS, SystemBarIcons and DialogEdgeToEdge are no-ops and deepLinkUri returns null, so invite links need iOS routing here. Strings.kt builds ResourceEnvironment through the resources library internal constructor (suppressed INVISIBLE_MEMBER); a Compose resources upgrade may break it, StringsTest pins it.
